title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I always enjoy discovering just how demented my mind is when I come up with tweets
Which one are you saving in the drafts?
Nah just the one I tweeted earlier. I had to massage it a bit
Because the way it was sounding was like, “The winning campers will get treated to a trip to 7-11 in Uncle Fen’s truck”
And I’m sitting here thinking, alright let’s not make this sound like you’re taking kids on a “want some candy” trip
And then I’m thinking, who the F would think that? Lol
You’re spending a lot of time thinking about tweets lately. You gotta take a break or something otherwise you go insane
Your right I could just keep thinking about the Tigers bullpen
A very good rebuttal
Good morning from Summer Camp, where today is Astronomy Awareness Day. No, Bobby, you’re not a dork if you like astronomy. Don’t be embarrassed about it, your friends will still think you’re cool.

Bobby, what do you have all over your hands? Were you playing in the pine tar mixed with Coke and whatever else to increase your spin rate pit? What do you mean no? It’s everywhere, under your hat, on your friend’s shin guards. Go take a shower, I’m calling your parents.
Ok I’m done
Ok, but that one was really funny
Do you get the workout list still?
[Attachment: Attachment]
It’s not up to date because JaCoby was scratched
Yeah
Was looking for Demeritte
Are you staking claim to any more days?
Talent show day. The rest are yours
I can’t believe the bullshit I’ve done for the last half hour
Nine days left, give or take. Gotta make sure we can get to the finish line
Good afternoon from Summer Camp, where it’s on. Today is the Fashion Show and Derek just challenged JaCoby to a walk-off in the old Members Only warehouse.
That’s pretty good
I’ll only give you two more, thumbs up or down. I got 9, though.
Tomorrow is going to be a really good one, I’m going to bring in a dozen Krispy Kreme donuts
Good morning from Summer Camp, where it is Donut Day. The sprinkles are for Al
Good evening from Summer Camp, where tonight is Campfire Stories With Cam. One time, when he was 20 years old, he hit a home run off Roger Clemens in Yankee Stadium. Cool story.
A little more fact-based
Liked the campfire angle, especially for the night game. And the last one for the night is ....
Good afternoon from Summer Camp, where Field Day is upon us. Stretching out in the infield for his showdown in the 60-yard dash against Derek Hill, it’s the challenger, Miguel Cabrera.
I don’t really want to double up on Derek Hill but the Zoolander reference was too good to pass up and is there anyone else that is considered fast?
Thank you for judging my tweets tonight, Greg
Gonna play my buddy in video games and go to bed
FUCK, field day is really really good. I’m
So upset
I still might find a way to incorporate that for another web gem or something because I like it so much.
That’s fair
Field Day has a lot of possibilities
Campfire one is very good. I’m trying to figure out how or if I might be able to use it. But it’s not going to too yours.
I wish they’d start playing night games
I don’t see why they’re not. They should get used to playing at night since like all of their games are at night
They should take a camp picture
Like they do a team photo
But socially distanced in the outfield
Might be funny I dunno
Or with masks on. I’ve been waiting for a team to do something like that
If I can get that idea to happen there’s a bottle of bourbon headed your way for the idea
Seriously, it would be a really good idea
Viral shit
It’s one of the best suggestions you’ve given yet. We’ve got a drone so we can get up high enough to take it
The Tigers Took A Socially-Distant Summer Camp Team Photo
I came up with one about Nick hitting a home run off Jay Sartori’s drone
Anyways
It would be two-pronged
It would be hilarious and it would be also for a cause
If you could get them all to wear masks and socially distance
